title: Table Occurrence Usage
description: How often every table occurrence is used and by what — layouts, portals, formulas, script steps, layout fields, value lists, lookups, security, relationships. Sorted by usage; unused, rarely and heavily used occurrences as filters; dead branches of the relationship graph told apart from intermediate occurrences that a path between two used ones runs through (e.g. the join TO of an n:m relationship). A row shows every usage with the using object.
author: fm-lab

params.name: file
params.description: Optional file filter — derived from the app-level filter.

params.name: rare_max
params.description: Threshold for 'rarely used': a used table occurrence with at most this many usages (default 3).

params.name: class
params.description: Usage class filter of the list (KPI tile): used, rare, heavy, bridge, dead_branch, dead_island, unused; empty = all. Sticky, so it combines with ddr; the 'All table occurrences' tile resets both.

params.name: ddr
params.description: List filter by DDR info (KPI tile): 'without' = only table occurrences of files exported without DDR info; empty = all. Sticky, so it combines with class; the 'All table occurrences' tile resets both.

params.name: q
params.description: Search term of the table occurrence list. Sticky: it survives KPI tile clicks and row clicks (the 'All table occurrences' tile resets only class and ddr); cleared in the search field.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort column of the table occurrence list (server sort). Sticky, like q.

params.name: dir
params.description: Sort direction of the table occurrence list (asc/desc). Sticky, like q.

params.name: to_uuid
params.description: Selected table occurrence (UUID) for the detail cards.

params.name: to_file
params.description: File of the selected table occurrence.
